key_insight: Active learning improves data efficiency for machine learning interatomic potentials by selecting reference calculations tailored to intended simulation conditions.
engineering_relevance: Adaptive training can focus costly reference calculations on configurations relevant to mechanics, diffusion, functional materials, and reactive dynamics.
method: Loop through candidate generation, data selection, reference calculation, and model updating.
Acquire configurations using uncertainty, model committees, or kernel- and representation-based criteria.
Adapt sampling to pretrained-model fine-tuning and far-from-equilibrium reactions.
evidence_signal: The review surveys more than 70 studies, emphasizing 2020–2026, but the abstract reports no pooled quantitative performance benchmark.
watch_item: Uncertainty estimates are architecture-dependent and may be least reliable in the unfamiliar configurations where reliable acquisition matters most.
paper_title: Active Learning for Interatomic Potentials: A Review of Uncertainty-Driven Data Efficiency
